## 🕵️ Welcome to **Git Quest**, agent @{login}!

I'm the Quest Master 🤖. I watch your fork, and every time you complete a mission I hand you a flag:
`SecurinetsENIT{...}` — **your flags are personal** (they're computed from your username), so sharing them is pointless 😉

**How it works**
1. I post your next mission here.
2. You do it in your terminal / on GitHub.
3. You comment **`/check`** on this issue → I inspect your fork and answer within ~30 seconds.

> 💡 Stuck? The *Hint* in my answer tells you exactly what I saw. Still stuck? Raise your hand 🙋
